title: Vertical stack with gap
summary: A flex column with gap spaces items evenly, with no margins on the children.
explanation: flex-direction: column turns the main axis vertical, so children stack top to bottom. Everything else about flexbox still applies.
gap puts space only between items. Margins on each child would also add space above the first and below the last, which is the usual reason spacing looks uneven.
tryThis: Remove flex-direction: column: the items sit side by side.
Replace gap with margin-bottom: 12px on .item and see the extra space after the last one.
